mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_attachment (approval_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, uploaded_at) VALUES (#{approvalId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{uploadedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT attach_id, approval_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, uploaded_at FROM approval_attachment WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId} ORDER BY uploaded_at, attach_id
